en-us.Greenside_Stroll_initial: The park path forks beneath a signpost: one way leads to the lawn, the other into the shade. The stroll starts here.
en-us.Greenside_Stroll_join: $joining.name$ reaches the park junction and checks the directions beside the signpost.
en-us.Greenside_Stroll_late: $joining.name$ arrives at the path entrance a little late and looks over the sign at the fork.
en-us.Greenside_Stroll_shared_initial: $attendees.name$ discuss the fork and choose the shaded path. By a bench, someone suggests a pause to watch birds hopping across the lawn. A question about whether the birds recognize regular visitors leads into talk about everyone's usual walking routes.
en-us.Greenside_Stroll_shared_arrival: $companions.name$ pause beside the signpost and point out the two paths to $joining.name$. They choose the shadier route; passing a bench, they agree to a brief rest and pick up a conversation about small sights along the way.
en-us.Greenside_Stroll_finish: Leaves rustle softly. The path continues deeper into the park.
en-us.Greenside_Cleanup_initial: Cleanup supplies stand beside the park meeting point. A notice marks today's cleanup area.
en-us.Greenside_Cleanup_join: $joining.name$ reaches the meeting point and checks the notice showing the cleanup area.
en-us.Greenside_Cleanup_late: $joining.name$ reaches the cleanup area a little later and sets personal belongings beside the path.
en-us.Greenside_Cleanup_shared_initial: $attendees.name$ divide a small task: holding a bag open and gathering a few scraps of paper beside the bench. Once the last scrap is inside, they close the bag, leaving this small spot a little tidier.
en-us.Greenside_Cleanup_shared_arrival: $companions.name$ and $joining.name$ split a small task, holding a bag open while gathering a few nearby scraps. With those scraps bagged and the opening gathered shut, that small task is done; the wider area still needs attention.
en-us.Greenside_Cleanup_finish: The supplies remain at hand. The reserved volunteer session is not over.
en-us.Greenside_Picnic_initial: A picnic table stands free beside the lawn, a patch of shade across its corner. The picnic session begins; food still needs to be brought along.
en-us.Greenside_Picnic_join: $joining.name$ reaches the lawn, sets down personal belongings and finds a comfortable spot.
en-us.Greenside_Picnic_late: $joining.name$ arrives at the lawn a little later and finds a place beside the picnic table.
en-us.Greenside_Playground_initial: The swings sway gently. There is room to move around the play equipment.
en-us.Greenside_Playground_join: $joining.name$ enters the playground and looks over the swings and climbing frame.
en-us.Greenside_Playground_late: $joining.name$ reaches the playground a little later and pauses beside the swings.
